Vendored third-party sources for the Lua scripting spike (Loader/Scripting/). Unmodified copy.

Lua 5.4.9 (PUC-Rio), MIT license
   Source:   https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.4.9.tar.gz (released 2026-08-10)
   SHA-256:  2335b6c582a52654f94612bf10d2f4672805d05329aa6568b1d8cd9e5c6fb8e6 (matches the lua.org download page)
   Copied:   src/*.c, src/*.h, src/lua.hpp, README. Not copied: Makefiles, doc/.
             lua.c (standalone interpreter) and luac.c (compiler) are present but excluded from the build in Scripting.lua.
   License:  LICENSE.txt (text from the end of src/lua.h)
   Build:    premake StaticLib "Lua", compiled AS C++ (lua_error -> C++ exception instead of longjmp, see
             docs/design/lua-scripting.md 2.3). Consumers must define SOL_USING_CXX_LUA=1 and must not wrap the
             Lua headers in extern "C".

Update procedure: replace the folder with the new upstream files, update versions/hashes here and the paths in
Loader/Scripting/Scripting.lua, rebuild and run the spike (Loader/Scripting/README.md).
